name: Text
description: A React Native component for displaying text. It supports nesting, styling, and touch handling.

data.name: style
data.description: Styles to apply to the text, such as color, fontSize, and fontWeight.

data.name: numberOfLines
data.description: Limits the text to a specified number of lines. Truncates with ... at the end.

data.name: ellipsizeMode
data.description: how to truncate the text when it exceeds the number of lines.

data.name: onPress
data.description: Function to be called when the text is pressed.

data.name: selectable
data.description: Values: true | false. If true, the user can select and copy the text.

example.title: Basic Text Usage
example.description: Examples of styling, nesting, and limiting lines of text.
